_comment: Canonical Gmail label specs for the Inbox Triage skill. Numeric prefixes (1/2/3) force Gmail's alphabetical sort to render left-to-right in the order: interest > seniority > source. Color pairs are validated Gmail palette pairs (background, text).

interest_labels.name: 1 Interested
interest_labels.meaning: Explicit interest in meeting / qualified use case / asking for time

interest_labels.name: 1 Maybe
interest_labels.meaning: Open to learning more but non-committal / soft interest

interest_labels.name: 1 Not Interested
interest_labels.meaning: Explicit decline / wrong person / unsubscribe-like language

seniority_labels.name: 2 ATL
seniority_labels.meaning: Above the Line: Director+, VP, Head of, Chief, C-level, or Senior Manager of program/roadmapping work

seniority_labels.name: 2 ATL Possible
seniority_labels.meaning: Borderline / title ambiguous (e.g., Senior Manager in unclear function, or LinkedIn lookup failed)

seniority_labels.name: 2 BTL
seniority_labels.meaning: Below the Line: IC, individual contributor, or Manager-and-below

source_labels.name: 3 Handraiser
source_labels.meaning: Website handraiser / explicit contact request (latest_handraiser_date_c populated)

source_labels.name: 3 MQL
source_labels.meaning: Marketing-generated: event, ebook, webinar, similar (lead_source_category_c = MKTG-Generated, no PSU/HR/CM signal)

source_labels.name: 3 Moving Champion
source_labels.meaning: Known Airtable champion who changed companies (is_cr_champion_mover_c = true)

source_labels.name: 3 Other
source_labels.meaning: Outbound-created / manual / untracked source (lead_source_category_c = Other or null)

archive_label.name: [ABDR Archived]
archive_label.meaning: Auto-archived by Inbox Triage: Gong/Zoom recording-ready notification, bounce, OOO, or other noise

_color_palette_reference: Gmail accepts only 102 specific hex values for label colors. Validated pairs in use: green (#42d692/#094228), yellow (#fef1d1/#eaa041), red (#f2b2a8/#8a1c0a), blue (#4986e7/#ffffff), pink (#fcdee8/#b65775), orange (#ff7537/#ffffff), light-orange (#ffdeb5/#7a4706), gray (#e7e7e7/#464646). GMAIL_CREATE_LABEL requires BOTH background_color AND text_color together.
